vulnerability.name: GO-2022-0635
vulnerability.description: Algorithm downgrade in the AWS SDK for Go v1 S3 crypto client

statements.impact_statement: Confii receives AWS credential discovery and request signing through HashiCorp's official Vault AWS auth module. Neither Confii module imports github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go/service/s3/s3crypto or calls its vulnerable encryption and decryption constructors. Govulncheck reports no reachable vulnerable symbol, and CI fails if the S3 crypto package enters either compiled dependency graph.
